benefits.name: Wireless provider credit
benefits.notes: Up to $10 a month, for up to $120 each calendar year.

benefits.name: Dell Technologies credit
benefits.merchant_scope: US purchases made directly with Dell Technologies
benefits.notes: Restructured on 2025-07-01 from $200 semiannually to $150 per calendar year. A further $1,000 credit unlocks after $5,000 of Dell spend in the same year; that tier is not tracked because the engine cannot express a spend threshold.

benefits.name: Adobe credit
benefits.merchant_scope: US purchases made directly with Adobe
benefits.notes: Requires at least $600 of Adobe spend in the calendar year before any credit posts. The engine cannot express a spend threshold, so this shows as claimable from January — treat it as conditional.

benefits.name: Global Lounge Collection access
benefits.notes: Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass Select and others. No dollar value is tracked.
